Grade datasheets and dimensioned drawings are issued on request, under NDA where required. Tell us what the pump handles and both temperatures — continuous and peak — and we will send the compatibility data for the compounds that suit it.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound — and because FKM, silicone and NBR shrink differently, each compound needs its own tool. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the worn inlay and tell us what the pump handles and how hot it runs. A used insert has taken a compression set and measures thinner than moulded, so we work to the housing and the free thickness, not to the sample. If the incumbent is FKM, tell us why — sometimes AEM at half the price covers it.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?

PDF, DWG, DXF and STEP. Mark the housing bore, the free thickness and the working compression — and state the medium and both temperatures, which decide the compound and grade before any dimension matters. Name the FKM grade if your drawing calls one out.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house, and post-cure is recorded on the batch record — it is what makes the FKM temperature rating real.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?
TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment.
